description: This PHP source file defines the class HookCollectorPass, which implements the CompilerPassInterface. It collects, processes, and registers hook implementations in a Drupal project, handling both class-based and procedural hooks, including attributes, includes, and ordering rules.

classes.name: Drupal\Core\Hook\HookCollectorPass
classes.description: A class that collects, processes, and registers hook implementations for Drupal modules, supporting class-based and procedural hooks, attributes, includes, and ordering.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Executes the collection of all hook implementations and writes the data to the container.

methods.name: writeToContainer
methods.description: Writes collected hook data, includes, and ordering rules into the container as a parameter.

methods.name: collectIncludesPerHook
methods.description: Collects include files associated with hook implementations, filtering out group includes.

methods.name: getFilteredImplementations
methods.description: Returns hook implementations after applying removals and filtering.

methods.name: calculateImplementations
methods.description: Calculates ordered hook implementations, considering module alterations and order operations.

methods.name: getOrderOperations
methods.description: Retrieves order operations grouped by hook, sorted by weight.

methods.name: applyOrderOperations
methods.description: Applies ordering rules to a list of hook implementations.

methods.name: registerHookServices
methods.description: Registers hook implementation classes as services in the container.

methods.name: collectAllHookImplementations
methods.description: Collects all hook implementations from modules, including procedural and class-based, using caching.

methods.name: getModuleListPattern
methods.description: Generates a regex pattern to match hook functions for a list of modules.

methods.name: collectModuleHookImplementations
methods.description: Scans module directories to find hook implementations via attributes and procedural functions.

methods.name: addProceduralImplementation
methods.description: Adds procedural hook functions to the collection, including special handling for hook_info and module_implements_alter.

methods.name: checkForProceduralOnlyHooks
methods.description: Throws exception if a hook attribute is used on a hook that only supports procedural implementation.

methods.name: getAttributeInstances
methods.description: Extracts attribute instances from class and method reflections.

methods.name: filterIterator
methods.description: Filters files during directory traversal to include only relevant PHP, inc, module, profile, install files, and specific directories.

methods.name: hasAnyAttribute
methods.description: Checks if any of the existing attributes match a list of expected attribute classes.
